text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm Silence Suzuka. I look forward to
working with
you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Although I don't have any specific
dreams to
speak of... I, um... I do like the
beautiful view
from first place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...The weather is lovely today. Would
you mind if
I went for a short jog?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
